articles.title: US Treasury sanctions over 100 ISIS-K crypto addresses that moved over $1.4 million
articles.snippet: ISIS-K allegedly used its media wing to solicit donations via Tron, Monero, and Bitcoin, highlighting stablecoin issuers' growing role in sanctions enforcement.

articles.title: India's central bank revives push to isolate banks from crypto: Report
articles.snippet: The Indian central bank reportedly urged lawmakers to keep banks insulated from crypto and private stablecoins while preserving room for regulated tokenization.

articles.title: CRCL Sell-Off 'Looks Overdone' Say Analysts as Circle CEO Addresses Open USD Threat
articles.snippet: Analysts don't think the threat of a new stablecoin launch was enough to warrant a major Circle (CRCL) sell-off on Tuesday.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Major New Stablecoin Launch Shakes Incumbents
articles.snippet: Open USD takes a shot at USDC and USDT, with backing from heavy hitters including Visa, Mastercard and Google.

articles.title: Taiwan Passes Sweeping Crypto Law With Licensing, Stablecoin Rules
articles.snippet: The new law puts virtual asset firms under FSC oversight for the first time and sets reserve-and-trust rules for stablecoins.
